_comment: THE SINGLE MCP CONFIG FOR EVERY ARCHON. W0/Protos/dev discover it; Genie/Jacques/Urist
are pointed at it explicitly with --mcp-config (their cwd is under Projects/, so there
is nothing to discover). NONE of them pass --strict-mcp-config any more: that flag
replaces EVERY config source, which silently cost those three lanes all 8 claude.ai
connectors. Verified 2026-08-24: dropping it alone yields 15 servers.
PER-LANE VALUES COME FROM THE ENVIRONMENT, NOT FROM FORKED COPIES OF THIS FILE.
Claude Code expands ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} here from the LAUNCHING process env.
The launcher exports these per lane; omitting an export yields the Jarvis default:
GRAPHITI_GROUP_ID    jarvis-core | genie-core | jaques-core | urist-core
ARXIV_STORAGE_PATH   per-project arxiv cache
SCHOLAR_DOWNLOAD_PATH  per-project paper cache
ANNAS_DOWNLOAD_PATH  per-project library cache
WHY THIS REPLACED per-persona mcp.json files (deleted 2026-08-24): they existed only to
carry those values, and they had ROTTED — all three had lost the mcp-hot-reload wrapper
and --watch on jarvis-rag and jarvis-graphiti, so three Archons ran without hot reload
and nothing surfaced it. Four files that must be kept in sync is a drift generator; one
file plus per-lane env makes drift structurally impossible. Do not re-fork this file.
SECRETS USE BARE ${VAR} WITH NO DEFAULT, DELIBERATELY. A default would re-embed the
secret in a tracked file AND make a failed export invisible, because the server would
authenticate fine even when the export silently did nothing. Non-secret values above
are the opposite case: a default is the correct Jarvis fallback.
